design: For mixed routes, reserve request or response body allocation against the same invocation budget before guest-memory copy; reserve Vec capacity and attach reservation to Bytes owner so clones retain accounting until last drop. Existing no-budget adapter path remains.
source: isolated reconstructed MCPGit candidate with shared Wasm budget and prerequisite input reservation; not current main or live deployment
service_tests: At 127 pages (8323072 bytes), 3MB output reservation denied with 5373969 bytes already reserved; Guest verifies earlier 3-byte response remains intact, emits its own 507 fallback, and later fresh input returns 200.
At 128 pages (8388608 bytes), same Guest returns exact 3000000-byte response; reported reservation at write 8373969 bytes; later fresh input returns 200.

Host adapter unit suite 5/5 passes, including request/response mutations and failed out-of-bounds/budget writes on Wasmi and Wasmtime; cloned request/response owners retain 6 bytes until their last clones drop.
Separate owner lifetime unit 1/1 confirms reservation held across Bytes clones.
preserved_observations: Initial 120-page baseline expected success but failed earlier at Wasm allocation; retained and not interpreted as response accounting.
128-page candidate initially expected rejection but succeeded with 8373966/8388608 reserved; corrected the boundary to 127 pages and retained the first log.
First lifetime test used partial name with --exact and selected zero tests; corrected rerun passed 1/1.
limitations: Tracks logical and Vec capacity for new binary request/response body writes, not allocator metadata or all Host heap, shared input backing, context, HTTP ingress, tables or compiled code.
Preexisting incoming request reservation occurs after transport allocation; does not cap the ingress peak.
Budget is invocation-local, not a system-wide or cross-invocation limit; reservations outlive owner clones but are not shared with later independent budgets.
Response outside binary exchange and other Host allocations still need accounting; no global memory proof.
Only isolated candidate Service, no integration or production Hosted validation; route files have active foreign claim.
Same-version optimized JSON Root is scratch, not permission to overwrite immutable identity; no formal release.
